query: Chimaja Appawas the younger brother of a general of the Maratha Empire in India, who served as what to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati Shahu from 1720 until his death?

retrieved_context: Shahu I: Shahu Bhonsle (1682–1749 CE) was the fifth Chhatrapati of the Maratha Empire created by his grandfather, Shivaji.  Shahu, he was taken prisoner with his mother in 1689 by Mughal General,Nusrat Jang.  He came out of captivity by the Mughals and defeated his aunt Tarabai in an internecine conflict to gain the throne in 1708.  After the death of Aurangzeb, leading Mughal courtiers released Shahu with a force of fifty men, thinking that a friendly Maratha leader would be a useful ally.

Chimaji Appa: Shreemant Chimaji Ballal Peshwa (aka Chimaji Appa)(1707–1740) was the son of Balaji Vishwanath Bhat and the younger brother of Bajirao Peshwa of Maratha Empire.  He was an able military commander who liberated the western coast of India from Portuguese rule.  The high watermark of his career was the capture of Vasai fort from the Portuguese in a hard fought battle.

Baji Rao I: Baji Rao (18 August 1700 – 28 April 1740) was a general of the Maratha Empire in India.  He served as "Peshwa" (Prime Minister) to the fifth Maratha Chhatrapati (Emperor) Shahu from 1720 until his death.  He is also known by the name Bajirao Ballal.
